# clean the data
```{r}
# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# read data
df <- read.csv("sentiment-survey-data.csv", 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# rename the col
colnames(df) <- c("feeling_words", "majority_feeling_guess", "instructor_feeling_guess")

# make a function to clean the data
clean_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("[\U0001F600-\U0001F6FF]", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:][:cntrl:]]", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s]", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", ",") %>%
    str_replace_all(",+", ",") %>%
    str_trim(side = "both") %>%
    tolower()
}

# use the function to clean
df_cleaned <- df %>%
  mutate(
    feeling_words = clean_text(feeling_words),
    majority_feeling_guess = clean_text(majority_feeling_guess),
    instructor_feeling_guess = clean_text(instructor_feeling_guess)
  )

# sep
df_cleaned <- df_cleaned %>%
  separate(feeling_words,
           into = c("first_feeling", "second_feeling",
                    "third_feeling", "fourth_feeling", "extra"),
           sep = ",", fill = "right", extra = "drop") %>%
  select(-extra)

# >=2 words, manually fix it
multi_majority_idx <-
  which(str_count(df_cleaned$majority_feeling_guess, ",") >= 1)
multi_instructor_idx <- 
  which(str_count(df_cleaned$instructor_feeling_guess, ",") >= 1)
majority_replacements <- 
  c("advance", "expected", "complex", "expected", "excited")
instructor_replacements <- 
  c("participated", "expected", "stressed", "happy", "excited")
# as a whole df
df_cleaned$majority_feeling_guess[multi_majority_idx] <- 
  majority_replacements
df_cleaned$instructor_feeling_guess[multi_instructor_idx] <- 
  instructor_replacements

# delete all NA
df_cleaned <- df_cleaned %>% drop_na()

# check
head(df_cleaned)
df_cleaned

# csv file of cleaned data
write.csv(df_cleaned, 
          "cleaned_sentiment_data.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
```


# plot
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

# read cleaned data
df <- read_csv("Hihi_H_cleaned_data.csv")

# combined data
long_data <- bind_rows(
  df %>%
    select(first_feeling, second_feeling, third_feeling, fourth_feeling) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "position", values_to = "feeling") %>%
    mutate(source_group = "Self"),
  
  df %>%
    select(feeling = majority_feeling_guess) %>%
    mutate(source_group = "Guess: Students"),
  
  df %>%
    select(feeling = instructor_feeling_guess) %>%
    mutate(source_group = "Guess: Instructors"))

# counted, grouped
heat_data <- long_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(feeling), feeling != "") %>%
  group_by(source_group, feeling) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# top 15 feelings
top_feelings <- heat_data %>%
  group_by(feeling) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(feeling)

heat_data_filtered <- heat_data %>%
  filter(feeling %in% top_feelings)

# heatmap
ggplot(heat_data_filtered, aes(x = source_group, y = fct_rev(feeling), fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    name = "Count",
    colours = c("#F4A7B9", "#FFDAB9", "#FFEB84"),
    limits = c(0, max(heat_data_filtered$count)),
    na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Feelings Across Groups",
       x = "Group",
       y = "Feeling") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 10, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave("Hihi-H-Graphic.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
```
